theorems.label: hamiltonian-sh-forward
theorems.statement: Under SH, for every fixed 0 < a < 1, no deterministic algorithm runs in 2^(O(p^a)) B^(O(1)) time for Hamiltonian Cycle by vertices or vertices plus edges, Hamiltonian Path by vertices, or Longest Path by the requested path length.

theorems.label: hamiltonian-size-sh-converse
theorems.statement: The fixed-power exclusion family for Hamiltonian Cycle by number of vertices plus edges implies SH.

title: Fixed-power lower bounds for Hamiltonian Cycle, Hamiltonian Path, and Longest Path
